transcript.content: Hello, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Hello. Well, I came in today because I just can't shake this absolute certainty that I'm being punished for letting my father decline. My sister tries to talk me out of it. She tells me I've done everything right, and she even shows me the doctor's notes to prove it, but... it doesn't change anything. It still feels like some sort of judgment has already been passed on me, and I don't know how to deal with it.
Do you believe with complete certainty that you are being punished, even though other people show you evidence that you are not?

Yes, exactly. Like I was just saying, she can show me all the medical notes in the world, and I'll look right at them, but it doesn't change anything in my head. It's hard to explain, but yes, I am completely certain. No matter what proof she gives me that I did things right, I just know I am being punished for his decline. It doesn't matter what anyone else says or shows me, it just feels like an absolute fact.
Have you been feeling depressed most of the day nearly every day?

Yes, I have. It's... well, most days I wake up with this heavy, hollow feeling. It's like the color has just gone out of everything. I can sit at my desk at work in HR, or just stare at the garden beds at home, and I feel like none of it reaches me anymore. It just stays like that pretty much the whole day.
Aside from this feeling of being punished, have you had any other beliefs that other people say are not true?

No, not really. It's just that one thing. I know we just talked about it, but that's really the only thing that stands out. I just have this absolute certainty that I'm being punished for letting my father decline. My sister keeps showing me his medical records and telling me I did everything I could, but none of it matters. I just know that a judgment has been passed on me for what happened to him. But other than that, no, I don't have any other beliefs like that.
Have you ever had a period where you felt abnormally high, euphoric, or unusually irritable?

No, I haven't. I've never felt anything like that. I don't get euphoric or abnormally high. Honestly, I just feel down and heavy all the time. I don't really have periods where I feel unusually energetic or irritable either, just... mostly just the sadness.
Have you been having thoughts of killing yourself?

No, I don't have a plan to hurt myself or anything like that. But... I do catch myself thinking it would just be easier if I didn't wake up. Especially on those mornings when I know there are going to be more calls from the care agency, and just... more problems waiting for me at work. It just feels like it would be a relief to not have to face it.
Does this belief that you are being punished only happen when you feel depressed?

Yes, it really does. I never had any thoughts like this before... I mean, I never believed I was being punished or heard those voices until this whole depression thing started. It all really settled in around the time my father started declining. I had been feeling just so low, guilty, and completely worn down for months before any of the punishment stuff or the voices began. So, yeah, it's only been since I've been feeling this depressed.
Before this current depression, have you ever had another period in your life when you felt depressed most of the day nearly every day for at least two weeks?

No, I've never felt like this before. This is the first time I've ever experienced anything like this. I mean, I've had normal sad days, but nothing that lasted for weeks or made me feel this heavy. It really just started with everything going on with my father. Before that, I was fine.
